subject: Regarding your recent job application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for submitting your application for the Marketing Coordinator position at XYZ Company. We appreciate your interest in joining our team. We have received your application and will be reviewing it carefully. Our hiring team will be in touch with you if your qualifications match our requirements. In the meantime, feel free to reach out if you have any questions or require further information. Best regards, Hiring Manager
